comments.author: phaer
comments.text:
Mostly just enshittified I am afraid.

Had the first incident of a website behind Cloudflare being DoS'ed last weekend.

Its webserver denied everything not coming from Cloudflare's origin IPs, we are on a paid plan, and the adding local PoW challenges on the webserver as a workaround immediately provided relief.

Could be that those DoS'ers just paid Cloudflares new-ish entrance fee for AI scrapers. But the effect is the same.
